title: The effects of technology intensity in manufacturing on CO2 emissions: evidence from developing countries
summary: The paper asks whether high-technology manufacturing emits less CO2 than medium- and low-technology manufacturing in developing economies. It concludes that a shift towards more technology-intensive manufacturing could be a more sustainable industrialisation path.
keyFindings: In exports, high-technology manufacturing is linked to lower emissions than medium- and low-technology exports.
A shift towards more technology-intensive manufacturing could be a more sustainable industrialisation path.
methods: Panel of 56 developing economies, 1991–2014, combining the environmental Kuznets curve and STIRPAT frameworks, estimated with GMM.
note: Revised and published as 'Greening manufacturing', Applied Energy 324 (2022), with partly different results.
